recommendedBaseline: A tactile editorial roast ledger with a flavor selector, stable six-bean catalogue, adapted brew recipe and subscription outcome.
showcaseDelta: A 12-shot scroll-authored physical roast sequence shows hopper loading, sampling, drum release, bean cascade and cooling rather than representing development with labels alone.
The bright, round or deep flavor choice propagates from the hero through bean emphasis, live brew values and the monthly subscription pairing.

mediaOpportunities.rationale: The machine and batch transformation are the clearest physical expression of Northwind's small-batch freshness claim.
Generic origin scenery would compete with the product-native machine sequence and require unverifiable farm-specific rights and identities.

agencyChain.userAction: Choose a bright, round or deep flavor profile.
agencyChain.immediateResponse: The recommended bean gains visible prominence while every product identity remains stable.
agencyChain.decisionOutcome: The brew values and monthly subscription recommendation change to match the stated taste.

mechanisms.name: Flavor continuity control
mechanisms.experienceRole: Starts the connected journey with a useful taste decision.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: One choice changes three non-adjacent product regions.
mechanisms.continuityConnection: Writes the shared profile state consumed by beans, brewing and subscription.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: Full-width vertical flavor rows remain touch-accessible.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: Showcase propagates the choice beyond card emphasis into downstream task outcomes.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors receive a bean and subscription recommendation matched to taste.
mechanisms.productTruth: Northwind's six coffees span distinct taste and roast profiles.
mechanisms.userCause: Visitor chooses bright, round or deep.
mechanisms.visibleChange: Accent color, selected product, brew data and subscription pairing change.
mechanisms.decisionConsequence: A concrete coffee and monthly pairing become actionable.
mechanisms.removalCost: The route would lose its connected personalization and return to a static catalogue.

mechanisms.name: Roastery proof ledger
mechanisms.primarySubject: Northwind's farm, price, batch and shipping proof
mechanisms.experienceRole: Turns brand claims into an operational ledger.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: Overscale counters and a paper-to-machine material handoff distribute craft before the Peak.
mechanisms.continuityConnection: Builds credibility between the hero promise and roast process.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: Proof resolves into a two-column ledger.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: Every proof point receives authored motion and material framing.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors understand why the freshness claim is credible.
mechanisms.productTruth: Northwind works with 11 farms, pays 2.4 times commodity price, roasts 12 kg and ships within 24 hours.
mechanisms.visibleChange: Proof values count into a ruled ledger.
mechanisms.decisionConsequence: The visitor can evaluate sourcing and freshness before shopping.
mechanisms.removalCost: The claims would remain unsupported marketing copy.

mechanisms.name: Stable bean comparison
mechanisms.experienceRole: Keeps product identities stable while allowing focused comparison.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: A product-native tasting field responds to the shared flavor state.
mechanisms.continuityConnection: Consumes the hero profile and supplies the subscription recommendation.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: A horizontal snap deck shows one complete bean at a time.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: Selection changes emphasis without reshuffling the catalogue.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors can compare and add any of six coffees.
mechanisms.productTruth: Six distinct lots with real notes, roast levels and prices are available.
mechanisms.userCause: The visitor clicks a bean card.
mechanisms.visibleChange: One card gains material prominence while all identities remain in place.
mechanisms.decisionConsequence: The chosen coffee becomes the downstream recommendation.
mechanisms.removalCost: The personalized journey would not produce a purchasable product.

mechanisms.name: Twelve-shot roast journey
mechanisms.primarySubject: The Probat and physical coffee batch
mechanisms.experienceRole: Shows how a green batch becomes same-day roasted coffee.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: Frame-edited physical mechanisms create the route's central transformation.
mechanisms.continuityConnection: Turns the earlier roast promise into evidence before the brew and subscription consequence.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: Machine stays fully contained above compact copy in a dedicated portrait stage.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: Recommended would use an interactive selector; Showcase makes the actual production process the primary journey.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors understand loading, development, sampling, release and cooling as one sequence.
mechanisms.productTruth: Northwind roasts 12 kg batches on a 1962 Probat and ships within hours.
mechanisms.userCause: The visitor scrolls forward or reverses through the process.
mechanisms.visibleChange: Hopper, beans, sampling trier, drum door, cascade, agitator, temperature and phase all change.
mechanisms.decisionConsequence: The freshness claim becomes credible enough to support purchase and subscription decisions.
mechanisms.removalCost: The site would lose its strongest proof of process, scale and same-day freshness.

mechanisms.name: Pour-over path
mechanisms.experienceRole: Translates the selected coffee into an executable brew ritual.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: A drawn water path connects live recipe values to four authored chapters.
mechanisms.continuityConnection: Uses profile-specific ratio and grind after the roast Peak.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: The path becomes vertical between clear recipe chapters.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: The recipe visibly develops rather than appearing as four ordinary cards.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors know how to brew the coffee successfully.
mechanisms.productTruth: Weight, fresh grinding, bloom and controlled pour determine the cup.
mechanisms.userCause: The visitor scrolls through the recipe.
mechanisms.visibleChange: The water path draws while step chapters enter.
mechanisms.decisionConsequence: The visitor can execute a three-minute pour-over.
mechanisms.removalCost: Product selection would not translate into preparation confidence.

mechanisms.name: Subscriber field notes
mechanisms.experienceRole: Adds human proof after the instructional release.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: Overscale editorial notes create a deliberate secondary rise.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: Each quote occupies a focused vertical chapter.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: Testimonials become authored evidence rather than repeated cards.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors see distinct reasons people value freshness and subscriptions.
mechanisms.productTruth: Subscribers cite flavor discovery, fast delivery and gifting.
mechanisms.visibleChange: Number, quote and attribution resolve in sequence.
mechanisms.decisionConsequence: Social proof reduces uncertainty before subscription.
mechanisms.removalCost: The route would lack human evidence.

mechanisms.name: Monthly pairing decision
mechanisms.experienceRole: Resolves discovery into a recurring-order decision.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: The recommendation materializes as two product-like physical planes and a direct start action.
mechanisms.continuityConnection: Uses the same profile and bean selected before the Peak.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: Reduced bag width and rotation preserve both identities without clipping.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: Showcase makes the choice visibly consequential after the central spectacle.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: A visitor can start a subscription that names their lead coffee and counterpoint.
mechanisms.productTruth: Northwind offers two 250 g bags monthly for $29 with free shipping and pauses.
mechanisms.userCause: The visitor activates the start-subscription action.
mechanisms.visibleChange: The paired recommendation remains visible while focus moves to the contact action.
mechanisms.decisionConsequence: The generic subscription becomes a specific, actionable recommendation.
mechanisms.removalCost: The journey would end in spectacle without a downstream product consequence.

mechanisms.name: Roastery message stamp
mechanisms.primarySubject: Direct contact with the two roasters
mechanisms.experienceRole: Closes the ledger with a real exchange.
mechanisms.ceilingContribution: The final state becomes a stamped received record.
mechanisms.continuityConnection: Returns to the timestamped ledger language introduced in the hero.
mechanisms.mobileTransformation: Form precedes a full-width touch target and compact success stamp.
mechanisms.recommendedDifference: Submission has a perceptible narrative resolution.
mechanisms.meaningfulOutcome: Visitors can send a valid message and receive clear feedback.
mechanisms.productTruth: The small team reads messages and replies within a day.
mechanisms.userCause: The visitor submits a valid email and optional message.
mechanisms.visibleChange: The form becomes a received stamp and confirmation.
mechanisms.decisionConsequence: The visitor knows the message was accepted.
mechanisms.removalCost: The route would lose its working human endpoint.
